title: AI Gateway Vertex AI tracing: pass enable_tracing into both Claude and MaaS delegates or passthrough span token usage is lost
answers: Vertex AI Claude streaming passthrough traces have no token usage attribute on the span
Where is enable_tracing set for the delegate providers behind a Vertex AI endpoint?
Why does the Gemini usage extractor return nothing for an Anthropic response on a Vertex AI endpoint?
body:
Path: Tracing and token-usage recording for Vertex AI passthrough requests, which runs through `mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:VertexAIProvider.__init__` (where the delegate is constructed) and `_extract_passthrough_token_usage` for non-streaming responses.
Rule: `VertexAIProvider.__init__` passes `enable_tracing` into `_VertexAIClaudeProvider` and `_VertexAIMaaSProvider`, which forward it to `BaseProvider.__init__`. Streaming passthrough accumulates usage on the delegate, and `BaseProvider._set_span_token_usage` does nothing when the delegate's own flag is False. Non-streaming usage must be read through the delegate's `_extract_passthrough_token_usage`, because the Gemini extractor looks for `usageMetadata` and returns nothing for an Anthropic response.
Symptom: Traces for streaming Claude passthrough on a Vertex AI endpoint had no token usage on the span.
Constraints: Applies when a new delegate is constructed or a usage extractor is added for a Vertex delegate. Gemini models use the Gemini path and are not affected.
applies: Applies to tracing and token usage for Vertex AI endpoints that route to a Claude or MaaS delegate.
says: Streaming Claude requests on Vertex AI endpoints show missing token usage in traces.
Gateway execution trace spans lack token counts for streaming calls to Vertex models.
Token usage is blank on trace details for Claude endpoints hosted on Vertex.
Record token metrics on traces when routing passthrough requests through Vertex AI delegates.
Non-streaming Vertex Claude calls do not capture token consumption in gateway trace spans.
search: In `mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:VertexAIProvider.__init__`, the `enable_tracing` parameter must be passed when instantiating `_VertexAIClaudeProvider` and `_VertexAIMaaSProvider` delegates. Without this flag set to True on delegates, `BaseProvider._set_span_token_usage` skips recording streaming token usage on trace spans, and non-streaming responses require the delegate's `_extract_passthrough_token_usage` rather than the Gemini extractor. Applies to delegate construction and token usage extractors for Vertex AI Claude and MaaS endpoints, while native Gemini models remain unaffected.
